title: the one launcher line, with a known flag set, is allowed explicitly (decision allow, never none)
source: .agents/hooks/jitso-dispatch-guard.test.ts: 'lets the launcher through, alone', 'with a required field', 'lets a dry run through'
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). The dispatch guard allows the launcher line with the flag `--build`, since that is the flag the launcher takes. The oracle guard still allows `--preset` only: it denies `--build` with `flag "--build" is not allowed`, so the allow decision FAILS on TS.
